note: Optional editorial override for the 'Topic of the day' tag. Set pin to { "topicId": "<id>", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD" } (date is the IST day) to force a specific topic for THAT day only; any other date is ignored, so a stale pin can never get stuck. Leave pin null to let the heat score choose automatically (see scripts/pipeline/lib/featured.js).
